# Existing Entraide matching package

The runtime imports `entraide-matching.js`, generated by:

```sh
node scripts/build-entraide-matching.mjs
```

Run this preparation step before checking or deploying the edge functions. It
requires the existing `../packages/purama-entraide` dependency from an authorized
checkout of `puramapro-oss/purama-master`, commit
`6e50837af08ad57d8db37077f0363b3e05289e31` (package version `0.1.0`).
The script verifies the source digest before bundling, and fails if the source
has changed. Review the canonical dependency before updating that digest.

The generated file is deliberately ignored by Git: the canonical package is in
a private repository, while `purama-ai` is public. Deployment bundles can include
it from the authorized workspace; the public source repository does not copy the
private source. There is no new matching engine and no request to an unpublished
`@purama/entraide@1.0.0` remote package.
